notes: ENG-OPS-003 Gap #13, closing #647 (follow-up of Gap6/#645). Two linked defects: (1) the titled bug — `docs:build`/`docs:dev` ran `pnpm --filter docs <script>` but docs/ is deliberately NOT a workspace member, so the filter matched zero projects and pnpm EXITED 0, reporting success while building nothing (the L20 silence-as-success footgun; `docs:dev` also called a `dev` script docs/ never defined — Docusaurus dev is `start`); (2) the content preset had no `path`, defaulting to the nonexistent docs/docs/ while the Markdown lives at docs/. Fix (minimal, gate-neutral): root scripts now run the standalone docs project directly (`pnpm --dir docs --ignore-workspace run build|start`) so the exit code propagates and the build hard-errors instead of silently succeeding; the preset declares an explicit `path: '.'` (+ minimal exclude) so it targets the real content root; docs/.gitignore added for the real build output; the pnpm-workspace.yaml rationale note refreshed. A full green site build is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE — docs/ is a kitchen-sink of GitHub-flavored Markdown that is MDX-hostile (malformed front matter, JSX-hostile syntax) and sidebars.js references non-existent doc IDs; curating it is an open-ended follow-up. Until it builds clean, docs/ stays OUT of the workspace (folding it in would drag docusaurus build into the required turbo Build gate — the #645 revert). No workspace fold, no docs/pnpm-lock.yaml removal, no docs-audit retirement (those ride the future curation PR). No pre-ship bypass, no --no-verify, no destructive git.
